sources.primary_title: EFGH and QuikBot Launch Real-Time Insurance for Autonomous Systems
sources.verified_angle_summary: QuikBot Technologies, led by CEO Alan Ng (a confirmed speaker at LEAP 2026), has formed a strategic partnership with Embed Financial Group Holdings (EFGH) to integrate real-time insurance directly into autonomous robotic systems. This partnership focuses on QuikBot's Ambient Permission Plane, ensuring that every action taken by an autonomous delivery robot—such as entering a building or completing a delivery—is automatically insured dynamically at the point of action. The collaboration shifts the paradigm from static insurance policies to contextual, embedded protection for physical AI. With QuikBot already deploying its robots in key Singaporean commercial sites and EFGH acting as the exclusive insurance partner, this development addresses the liability bottleneck in scaling autonomous urban logistics, making it a highly distinct and material deep-tech angle relevant to LEAP 2026 themes.
sources.verified_key_facts: QuikBot Technologies and Embed Financial Group Holdings (EFGH) signed a Strategic Partnership Agreement on March 2, 2026; EFGH will serve as the exclusive insurance partner for QuikBot’s Ambient Permission Plane; the partnership embeds real-time insurance into autonomous actions, such as a robot entering a building; coverage includes public liability, cyber liability, product liability, property damage, and cargo-in-transit; QuikBot has live deployments at Singapore sites including South Beach and Mapletree Business City; the partnership expands EFGH's Finternet strategy into embedded insurance; Alan Ng, CEO of QuikBot, is a featured speaker at LEAP 2026.
